where: blaze: an idle daemon and the kernel's pressure figures
what: With one idle blaze daemon and nothing else running, `/proc/pressure/io` said `full avg10=98.95` and `/proc/stat`'s iowait grew by 99% of all CPU time, while the disk wrote 8 requests in 5 s and no task was in state D: the daemon's threads wait in io_uring, which the kernel counts as waiting on I/O.
cost: ten minutes looking for a disk fault that was not there
cause: io_uring waits are accounted as iowait
workaround: read `/proc/diskstats`, not the pressure file, when a daemon is alive
